name: update_logical_view

LogicalView.description: A simplified mcp version of the SQL logical view object.

deletionProtection.description: Optional. Set to true to make the LogicalView protected against deletion.

name.description: Identifier. The name of the logical view.

query.description: Required. The logical view's select query.

instanceId.description: Required. The instance ID within the project where the logical view will be created (e.g., "my-instance").

logicalView.description: Required. The logical view to update.

logicalViewId.description: Required. The ID used for the logical view within its instance, e.g., `mylogicalview`.

projectId.description: Required. The project ID (e.g., "my-project"). If not known from the context, the Agent should attempt to get the current project ID from the gcloud config by running `gcloud config get-value project`. If the attempt fails, prompt the user for the project ID.
